atiyah-macdonald.title: Introduction to commutative algebra
atiyah-macdonald.level_note: Grew out of a third-year undergraduate course at Oxford (the authors' introduction), but is the standard first graduate text on the subject elsewhere; filed at the level it is read at.
atiyah-macdonald.locator_convention: chapter-item: (chapter, 0, n) is the numbered body item chapter.n (propositions, theorems, corollaries and the exercises interleaved with them share one sequence); (chapter, 1, n) is exercise n at the end of the chapter. Body items therefore sort before the exercises that depend on them.

harvested.13: chapters 1-9, body and exercises, at 0.4.0 (chapter 1 at 0.3.0)

reid-ucai.title: Undergraduate commutative algebra
reid-ucai.locator_convention: paragraph: Reid numbers paragraphs chapter.section; (chapter, section, 0) is the paragraph's own statement, (chapter, section, 1) the corollary that follows it, higher items further numbered statements within it. Exercises to chapter n are (n, 99, exercise number).

harvested.13: chapter 1 and 5.12-5.14 with exercises, for cross-citation of the Atiyah-Macdonald chapter 1 batch at 0.3.1

matsumura-crt.title: Commutative ring theory
matsumura-crt.locator_convention: numbered-section: sections are numbered continuously across chapters (section 1 is in chapter 1, section 4 in chapter 2); (chapter, s, n) is Theorem s.n; exercises to section s are (chapter, s, 100 + exercise number); numbered Examples in section s are (chapter, s, 200 + example number).

harvested.13: sections 1 and 4 with exercises, for cross-citation at 0.3.1

matsumura-crt.note: translated from the Japanese by M. Reid

eisenbud-ca.title: Commutative algebra
eisenbud-ca.locator_convention: chapter-item: Eisenbud numbers results chapter.item independently of section, so (chapter, 0, n) is result chapter.n (Proposition, Corollary, Lemma or Theorem) and (chapter, 1, n) is Exercise chapter.n.
eisenbud-ca.note: with a view toward algebraic geometry

dummit-foote.title: Abstract algebra
dummit-foote.level_note: A general first algebra text; only chapters 7-9 and 15-16 are commutative algebra, and those are the first exposure most students get.
dummit-foote.locator_convention: section-item: (chapter, section, n) is numbered item n of that chapter (Dummit-Foote number propositions, theorems and corollaries in one sequence per chapter), cited as §chapter.section, no. n; exercises are (chapter, section, 100 + exercise number).

harvested.13: 7.4, 7.6, 10.5, 15.2-15.5, 16.1-16.3 with exercises, via the djvu text layer, for cross-citation at 0.3.0
harvested.15: chapters 11-12, numbered results only, for cross-citation at 0.3.0
harvested.20: chapters 1-6, numbered results and exercises, via the djvu text layer, at 0.3.0 (branch corpus/commutative-algebra)

rudin-pma.title: Principles of mathematical analysis
rudin-pma.series: International Series in Pure and Applied Mathematics
rudin-pma.locator_convention: chapter-item: Rudin numbers every definition, theorem and remark chapter.n in one sequence, so (chapter, 0, n) is item chapter.n; (chapter, 1, n) is exercise n at the end of the chapter.

harvested.26: chapters 1-7, body and exercises, at 0.3.0 (branch corpus/commutative-algebra)

rudin-rca.title: Real and complex analysis
rudin-rca.locator_convention: chapter-item: items are numbered chapter.n in one sequence per chapter, so (chapter, 0, n) is item chapter.n; (chapter, 1, n) is exercise n at the end of the chapter.

abbott.title: Understanding analysis
abbott.locator_convention: section-theorem: Abbott numbers results chapter.section.n, so (chapter, section, n) is Theorem chapter.section.n; exercises are numbered chapter.section.n too and are recorded as (chapter, section, 100 + n).

harvested.26: numbered theorems of chapters 1-8 matched against the Rudin batch for cross-citation; not yet harvested for its own exercises

axler-ladr.title: Linear algebra done right
axler-ladr.locator_convention: chapter-item: results are numbered chapter.n in one sequence per chapter, so (chapter, 0, n) is result chapter.n; (chapter, 1, n) is exercise n at the end of the chapter.

harvested.15: chapters 1-10, numbered results and end-of-chapter exercises, at 0.3.0 (branch corpus/commutative-algebra)

hoffman-kunze.title: Linear algebra
hoffman-kunze.locator_convention: section-item: theorems are numbered per chapter and exercises per section, so (chapter, section, n) is Theorem n of that chapter, read in section chapter.section; exercises are (chapter, section, 100 + exercise number).

harvested.15: selected theorems of chapters 1-10, read from the text layer, at 0.3.0 (branch corpus/commutative-algebra)

roman-ala.title: Advanced linear algebra
roman-ala.locator_convention: chapter-item: theorems are numbered chapter.n in one sequence per chapter, so (chapter, 0, n) is Theorem chapter.n; (chapter, 1, n) is exercise n at the end of the chapter.

harvested.15: selected theorems of chapters 1-3 and 7-11, read from the page images (the text layer is garbled), at 0.3.0 (branch corpus/commutative-algebra)

lang-algebra.title: Algebra
lang-algebra.locator_convention: section-item: chapters are numbered I, II, ... and recorded as 1, 2, ...; theorems are numbered per section, so (chapter, section, n) is Theorem section.n of that chapter; exercises are per chapter and recorded as (chapter, 99, exercise number).

harvested.20: chapter I, numbered results and end-of-chapter exercises, via the djvu text layer, at 0.3.0 (branch corpus/commutative-algebra)
